post.description: POST to the originating credential's webhook URL configured when this delivery attempt is claimed. Owners can edit an active key's URL in the portal without rotating its signing secret; queued retries use the updated URL, while in-flight attempts may use the previous URL. The URL below is a placeholder, not an API endpoint. HMAC-SHA256 uses the webhook secret over UTF-8 timestamp + '.' + exact raw request bytes. X-Fondeka-Signature is v1=<lowercase hex>. Verify in constant time, reject stale timestamps (recommended ±300s), validate environment and deduplicate event ID before fulfillment. Return any 2xx after durable acceptance. Non-2xx, redirects and transport failures retry up to 10 attempts with 30/60/120/240/480/960/1800/1800/1800-second scheduled delays; scheduling can be later. IDs and payload bytes stay fixed; attempt timestamp/signature change. Revoked credentials still deliver accepted payments. Payments still ACCEPTED or PROCESSING do not emit terminal events. Cancellation/expiry generate failed events. No ordering guarantee across payments.

post.description: Accept an asynchronous mobile-money or crypto payout. Reserve/debit the account fiat wallet gross amount including fees at acceptance. Crypto token amounts are quoted server-side. A completed payout does not debit again. ACCEPTED means queued; PROCESSING includes execution and unresolved provider outcomes. Both keep funds reserved; do not submit a replacement payment while investigating.

parameters.description: Required per logical intent. Reuse exactly on retries; changed normalized content returns 409. Payments are scoped to Business+environment; sandbox funding/conversion keys are account-scoped per operation.

parameters.description: SANDBOX only. Select a requestErrors code for an immediate HTTP rejection without side effects, or a processingErrors code for an accepted asynchronous outcome. Read paymentMethodTypes and resultingStatus: terminal failures expose failureCode in polling/webhooks; CRYPTO_CONFIRMATIONS_PENDING remains PROCESSING with no terminal webhook or payout refund. Real authentication, ownership and access checks run first. Blank, unknown or unsupported codes return 400 INVALID_TEST_ERROR_CODE. Omit for normal success. LIVE credentials ignore any value, regardless of server profile.

get.description: LIVE keys read the owning account's real fiat wallets; SANDBOX keys read isolated virtual wallets. Businesses under the same account share balances within their environment. An absent wallet queried by currency has zero balance.

parameters.description: Business ID associated with this API key. A foreign Business returns 403.
parameters.name: businessId

parameters.description: ISO fiat currency, normalized to uppercase. Omit on wallet listing to return all existing wallets.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: SANDBOX only. Select a requestErrors code for an immediate HTTP rejection without side effects, or a processingErrors code for an accepted asynchronous outcome. Read paymentMethodTypes and resultingStatus: terminal failures expose failureCode in polling/webhooks; CRYPTO_CONFIRMATIONS_PENDING remains PROCESSING with no terminal webhook or payout refund. Real authentication, ownership and access checks run first. Blank, unknown or unsupported codes return 400 INVALID_TEST_ERROR_CODE. Omit for normal success. LIVE credentials ignore any value, regardless of server profile.
